web.v3.portrait.gameplay.noTimer.notes: Quiet background patch only, x713 y1158; no timer when human deadline absent or reconnecting. Uses independent lower action per safe-v2.

web.v3.reconnecting.notes: Independent transparent authored dialog, not the full scene. Current-state Chrome QA still required.

web.v3.portrait.reconnecting.notes: Small red fringe remains a QA finding.

web.v3.portrait.sessionEnded.notes: Retains independent portrait layout; small red fringe remains a QA finding.

web.v3.portrait.playAction.notes: Independent blank plaque, intrinsic aspect preserved. Slight proportion and brush drift remain; no stretched baked action over card targets.

web.v3.gameplay.noAction.notes: Quiet scene-only crop x1235 y665 from independent ImageGen cleanup; removes the baked empty action during chooser/recovery only. Bid still uses that action lane.

web.v3.lobby.invite.notes: Independent cloud-ended parchment with invariant group/label painted in; accessible live button remains semantic. Intrinsic proportions retained.

web.v3.lobby.addControl.notes: Independent generated dark-gold frame/robot, no baked mutable label; alpha canvas trimmed only.

web.v3.lobby.removeControl.notes: Independent generated dark-gold frame/minus, no baked mutable label.

web.v3.lobby.wifiIcon.notes: PC only; portrait source has no extra connection chip. Recovery remains blocking in both profiles.

web.v3.lobby.robotIcon.notes: Standalone PC icon over the scene's existing button frame. Portrait uses the complete generated control instead, never two frames.

web.v3.lobby.readyState.content: Same four humans all ready, one AI and one empty; creator auto-fill allows start. State source only; actual permission and text remain server-backed.

web.v3.rules.font.notes: Rules h3/body/step labels and setting labels. Preserve all shaping features; portrait punctuation uses halt. Numeric badges and Cocos unchanged; other web labels use the independent UI font entry.

web.v3.ui.font.notes: Lobby/results/ranking Chinese lettering only. CSS Unicode range retains Noto for digits/Latin; rare glyphs also fall back. Never ship full experimental TTFs.

web.v3.results.avatars.notes: These source masters show the same half-body originals as the lobby. Sleepy cat and human traveler retain their separate result identities. No extra circular mask or baked duplicate frame.

notes: Generated scene size is 1672x941; measure actual output rather than assuming requested 1920x1080.

Cocos resource generation is unchanged; this manifest belongs exclusively to the internal browser carrier.
